blocks.card.credential: Student Counselor, supervised by Tony Gore, LCSW
blocks.card.summary: Children, teens, and young adults, with play and art therapy.
blocks.hero.subhead: Helps children, teens, and young adults, especially adolescent girls, who feel anxious, overwhelmed, or disconnected learn to express what's going on inside and build tools for confidence and connection.
blocks.quote: You don't have to have the right words yet. We can draw, play a game, or just talk. We'll find what works for you.

sections.heading: Who Sophie works with
sections.body: Sophie works with children 8 and up, teens, and young adults, especially girls and young women working through anxiety, identity, stress, low mood, and self-esteem. Many are in a season of change: a new school, a hard season at home, or wanting more say in their own lives.

sections.heading: Sophie's approach
sections.body: Sophie is a Student Counselor, and her clinical work is supervised by Tony Gore, LCSW. Her style is warm, down-to-earth, and collaborative. Sessions may include conversation, drawing, card games, or creative homework, adapted to how each young person learns and expresses themselves.

blocks.practical.body: In person in Middletown or online. Usually seen the same week.
blocks.faith.heading: Faith
blocks.faith.body: When a family wants Christian integration, Sophie is glad to pray with or for her clients and include Scripture and faith reflection where it fits. When a family doesn't, she follows their lead.
blocks.request.heading: Ready to start with Sophie?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment with Sophie, or call (502) 523-2970.
